parse_requirements: parse a requirements.txt file and return a list of non-empty non-comment requirement lines
setup_spider_package: configure and install the spider package with setuptools including dependencies and entry points
install_spider_dev: install the spider package with dev extras including ruff for linting and formatting
run_spider_mjwp: run the spider-mjwp console script entry point from examples.run_mjwp main function
review_setup_config: review the spider package setup configuration including python version requirements and package includes
